title: pvImageDataToUniformGrid
body:
## pvImageDataToUniformGrid

Converts image data (vtkImageData, or composite data whose leaves are images) into a vtkUniformGrid with blanking: a single-component point or cell array marks which points or cells are hidden. Values strictly between -1 and 1 (effectively zero) hide the element and other values keep it; Reverse swaps this. The blanking is written as a vtkGhostType array of hidden points or cells, which rendering and blanking-aware filters skip. Use it to mask solid or invalid regions of a regular grid without changing its structure.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A value such as 0.5 counts as zero and is hidden; use a mask array of clear 0 and 1 values.
- The array must have exactly one component; vector arrays are rejected.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ImageDataToUniformGrid`. Identity: `filters/ImageDataToUniformGrid`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData","vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
